Resolves #19585

After a resize, `SharedCanvas` now keeps the event's viewport rectangle for pointer conversion and its content-box dimensions for renderer sizing. Pointer forwarding remains synchronous. The existing `updateSize` helper accepts the pointer rectangle separately; one-argument and initial-measurement callers retain their behavior.

Evidence: L3 browser resize and native pointer delivery observed; L3 required by AC-4. No remaining evidence residual.

## AC Evidence
| Criterion | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `canvas/PointerInput.spec.mjs` exercises resize before click with zero and padding-relative content origins. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same control pins content-box dimensions, DPR 2, window ID, modifiers, unchanged event delivery and the initial measurement fallback. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI red control: old source forwards `(51,174)` where `(30,20)` is required; repaired control passes. Existing pointer, visibility and ResizeObserver suites pass. |
| AC-4 | Outside-CI: `node test-results/19585/browser-probe.cjs [--baseline]`; [paired GraphScene receipt and complete driver](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19586#issuecomment-6104438456). |

## Deltas from ticket
The independent prescription read caught that remeasuring a bounding box would change content-box sizing. The existing resize payload already carries both rectangles, so the repair adds no DOM round trip.

## Test Evidence
The public GraphScene example reproduced the old pointer offset and passed at this head with the same resize and native input. The complete AC-4 receipt above includes both source revisions, measurements, instrumentation and driver. This is a Chromium witness; no broader platform claim.

The local full-unit run had eight sandbox-permission failures (npm cache and loopback binding); all three affected suites passed on the scoped native rerun with a temporary npm cache. No production source was changed for that rerun.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here. Repository pre-commit guards and the file-size check passed; hosted baseline checks remain the handoff gate.

## Post-Merge Validation
None required for this bounded coordinate restoration.

```javascript
const {execFileSync} = require('node:child_process');
const fs             = require('node:fs/promises');
const http           = require('node:http');
const net            = require('node:net');
const path           = require('node:path');
const {pathToFileURL}= require('node:url');
const {chromium}     = require('playwright');

const
    root          = path.resolve(__dirname, '../..'),
    baseline      = process.argv.includes('--baseline'),
    suffix        = baseline ? '-baseline' : '',
    appPath       = '/examples/component/graphScene/',
    canvasName    = 'Neo.examples.component.graphScene.SceneCanvas',
    rendererPath  = '/examples/component/graphScene/canvas/Renderer.mjs',
    sharedPath    = '/src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs',
    outputBase    = path.join(__dirname, `browser-probe${suffix}`),
    mime          = {'.css': 'text/css', '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.json': 'application/json', '.mjs': 'text/javascript', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.wasm': 'application/wasm', '.woff2': 'font/woff2'},
    delay         = ms => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function reservePort() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const server = net.createServer();
        server.once('error', reject);
        server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
            const port = server.address().port;
            server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve(port))
        })
    })
}

async function serveRepository() {
    const server = http.createServer(async (request, response) => {
        try {
            const pathname = decodeURIComponent(new URL(request.url, 'http://localhost').pathname);
            let file = path.resolve(root, `.${pathname}`);
            if (file !== root && !file.startsWith(`${root}${path.sep}`)) return response.writeHead(403).end();
            if ((await fs.stat(file)).isDirectory()) file = path.join(file, 'index.html');
            response.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': mime[path.extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store'});
            response.end(await fs.readFile(file))
        } catch {
            response.writeHead(404).end()
        }
    });

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        server.once('error', reject);
        server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve)
    });

    return {server, origin: `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`}
}

function addPointerSnapshot(source) {
    const needle = 'return {...super.getStats(), lodLap:';
    if (source.split(needle).length !== 2) throw new Error('GraphScene getStats anchor changed');
    return source.replace(needle, 'return {...super.getStats(), pointer: {...this.mouse}, lodLap:')
}

function instancesFrom(response) {
    return response?.instances || response?.result?.instances || response?.data?.instances || response || []
}

async function readStats(service, sessionId, id) {
    const response = await service.callMethod({sessionId, id, method: 'getStats', args: []});
    return response?.result ?? response?.data ?? response
}

async function main() {
    const
        report = {
            schemaVersion: 'neo-canvas-pointer-origin-probe.v1',
            mode         : baseline ? 'baseline' : 'candidate',
            example      : 'examples/component/graphScene',
            viewport     : {width: 1000, height: 800}
        };
    let server, browser, context, connection, bridgeStarted = false;

    try {
        const bridgePort = await reservePort();
        process.env.NEO_NL_PORT = String(bridgePort);
        process.env.NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT = path.resolve(root, '../neo-agent-brain');

        const fixture = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(root, 'test/playwright/fixtures.mjs')).href),
              services = await fixture.loadNeuralLinkModules();
        connection = services.NeuralLink_ConnectionService;
        connection.cwd = services.bridgeScriptRoot;
        if (services.aiConfig.port !== bridgePort) throw new Error('Isolated Bridge port was not retained');
        await connection.manageConnection({action: 'start'});
        bridgeStarted = true;

        const host = await serveRepository();
        server = host.server;
        browser = await chromium.launch({headless: true});
        context = await browser.newContext({viewport: {width: 1280, height: 900}, deviceScaleFactor: 1});

        await context.route('**/neo-config.json*', async route => {
            const response = await route.fetch();
            if (!response.ok()) return route.fulfill({response});
            await route.fulfill({response, json: {
                ...await response.json(),
                useAiClient: true,
                neuralLinkUrl: `ws://127.0.0.1:${bridgePort}`
            }})
        });

        await context.route(`**${rendererPath}`, async route => {
            const response = await route.fetch();
            if (!response.ok()) return route.fulfill({response});
            await route.fulfill({response, body: addPointerSnapshot(await response.text())})
        });

        if (baseline) {
            const source = execFileSync('git', ['show', 'origin/dev:src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs'], {cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8'});
            await context.route(`**${sharedPath}`, async route => {
                await route.fulfill({response: await route.fetch(), body: source})
            })
        }

        const page = await context.newPage(), pageErrors = [], consoleErrors = [];
        page.on('pageerror', error => pageErrors.push(error.message));
        page.on('console', message => message.type() === 'error' && consoleErrors.push(message.text()));
        await page.goto(`${host.origin}${appPath}`, {waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded'});
        await page.waitForFunction(() => !!window.Neo?.worker?.App?.getWorkerId, null, {timeout: 20000});

        const worker = await page.evaluate(() => Neo.worker.App.getWorkerId()),
              workerId = typeof worker === 'string' ? worker : worker?.data,
              sessionId = await connection.waitForSession(workerId, 20000),
              discoverUntil = Date.now() + 20000;
        let canvas;

        while (Date.now() < discoverUntil) {
            const found = await services.NeuralLink_ComponentService.queryComponent({
                sessionId,
                selector: {className: canvasName},
                returnProperties: ['id', 'className', 'windowId', 'isCanvasReady', 'canvasRect']
            });
            canvas = found.components?.find(item => item.className === canvasName);
            if (canvas?.id && canvas.properties.isCanvasReady) break;
            await delay(100)
        }

        if (!canvas?.id || !canvas.properties.isCanvasReady) throw new Error('GraphScene SceneCanvas did not become ready');
        await services.NeuralLink_InstanceService.setInstanceProperties({
            sessionId, id: canvas.id, properties: {style: {margin: '20px'}}
        });
        await page.setViewportSize(report.viewport);

        let bounds, canvasRect, renderer;
        const settleUntil = Date.now() + 7000;
        while (Date.now() < settleUntil) {
            bounds = await page.locator(`#${canvas.id}`).boundingBox();
            const props = await services.NeuralLink_InstanceService.getInstanceProperties({
                sessionId, id: canvas.id, properties: ['canvasRect']
            });
            canvasRect = props.properties?.canvasRect;
            renderer = await readStats(services.NeuralLink_InstanceService, sessionId, canvas.id);
            if (bounds && renderer.canvas?.[0] === bounds.width && renderer.canvas?.[1] === bounds.height && renderer.frames > 0) break;
            await delay(100)
        }

        if (!bounds || !canvasRect || renderer?.contextLost || !renderer?.uploaded || renderer.frames < 1) throw new Error('Canvas geometry or renderer stats did not settle');

        const expected = {x: 30, y: 20};
        await page.mouse.move(bounds.x + expected.x, bounds.y + expected.y);
        await page.mouse.down();
        await page.mouse.up();

        const pointerUntil = Date.now() + 5000;
        let pointer = null;
        while (Date.now() < pointerUntil) {
            renderer = await readStats(services.NeuralLink_InstanceService, sessionId, canvas.id);
            pointer = renderer.pointer;
            if (pointer && pointer.x > -100) break;
            await delay(100)
        }

        const
            cachedOrigin = {
                x: typeof canvasRect.x === 'number' ? canvasRect.x : canvasRect.left,
                y: typeof canvasRect.y === 'number' ? canvasRect.y : canvasRect.top
            },
            originAligned = Math.abs(cachedOrigin.x - bounds.x) <= 1 && Math.abs(cachedOrigin.y - bounds.y) <= 1,
            pointerAligned = Boolean(pointer) && Math.abs(pointer.x - expected.x) <= 1 && Math.abs(pointer.y - expected.y) <= 1,
            baselineMismatch = !originAligned && !pointerAligned;

        report.canvas = {className: canvas.className, bounds, cachedCanvasRect: canvasRect};
        report.expectedLocalPointer = expected;
        report.canvasWorkerPointer = pointer;
        report.rendererStats = {
            contextLost : renderer.contextLost,
            uploaded    : renderer.uploaded,
            frames      : renderer.frames,
            canvas      : renderer.canvas
        };
        report.originAligned = originAligned;
        report.pointerAligned = pointerAligned;
        report.pageErrors = pageErrors;
        report.consoleErrors = consoleErrors;
        report.result = baseline ? (baselineMismatch ? 'expected-mismatch' : 'unexpected-pass') :
            (originAligned && pointerAligned ? 'pass' : 'fail');
        report.screenshot = path.basename(`${outputBase}.png`);
        await page.screenshot({path: `${outputBase}.png`, fullPage: true});

        if (pageErrors.length || consoleErrors.length) throw new Error('Browser reported a page or console error');
        if (baseline && !baselineMismatch) throw new Error('origin/dev baseline did not reproduce the mismatch');
        if (!baseline && report.result !== 'pass') throw new Error('candidate did not preserve the viewport origin and local pointer');
    } catch (error) {
        report.result = 'error';
        report.error = String(error?.message || error).replaceAll(root, '<repo>')
    } finally {
        await context?.close().catch(() => {});
        await browser?.close().catch(() => {});
        if (server) await new Promise(resolve => server.close(resolve));
        if (bridgeStarted) await connection.manageConnection({action: 'stop'}).catch(() => {});
        await fs.writeFile(`${outputBase}.json`, `${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`);
        console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
        if (['error', 'fail', 'unexpected-pass'].includes(report.result)) process.exitCode = 1
    }
}

main().then(() => process.exit(process.exitCode || 0)).catch(error => {
    console.error(String(error?.message || error).replaceAll(root, '<repo>'));
    process.exit(1)
});
```

**Challenge (per guide §7.1):**

1. **Failure mode on a missing `data.rect` changes shape.** `DomEvents.getTargetData` omits `rect` only for scroll and wheel (`:11-14`), so a resize entry always carries it; but if a caller ever passes a resize payload without `rect`, `canvasRect` becomes `undefined` and `forwardPointer` goes silent (no pointer at all) where the old source forwarded wrong coordinates. I verified the only two-argument caller is `onDomResize` with the main thread's payload, so this is a documented edge, not a defect — the silence is arguably the more honest failure.
